specification.rule: EvalDeclarationInstantiation step 13 (Normative Optional block-level functions): the bindingExists walk skips the Catch clause Environment Record when VariableStatements in Catch Blocks (B.3.4) is supported, so a var binding is created in the function VariableEnvironment and FunctionDeclaration evaluation performs variableEnv.SetMutableBinding with the block function.

rootCause.detail: For entryKind direct-eval the top-level annexVariableRecord is undefined, so the Annex B copy lowers to setGlobalBinding($global, ...). The runtime admission (instantiateDirectEvalDeclarations) correctly exempts the catch record and creates g in the caller variable record, but evaluation writes the global object instead: the function-scope binding stays undefined and the function leaks onto globalThis.
rootCause.staticProbe: lowerDirectEvalScript("{ function g(){ return 3; } }", flags=directEvalInFunction) emits getBindingValue + setGlobalBinding and no setMutableBinding on $site.variables.declarative.
